name: Amphenol
description: Amphenol designs and makes connectors, cables, sensors, antennas and interconnect systems that carry power and signals inside other companies' products. It sells them to equipment makers in IT data centres and networking, cars, industrial machinery, aircraft, defense, mobile phones and telecom networks; about 350 factories in about 40 countries are vertically integrated, and most products are custom-designed with the customer. Growth is driven by volume into AI data centres (IT datacom was about 36% of 2025 sales) and by a steady stream of acquisitions; the largest in its history, CommScope's Connectivity and Cable Solutions business, closed on 2026-01-09.

employees.note: Approximately 170,000 employees worldwide, about 15,000 in the United States.

businessLines.name: Communications Solutions
businessLines.how: Sells high-speed, RF, power and fiber-optic connectors, cable and antennas to server, networking and telecom equipment makers and handset and car makers; one-time product sales on design wins, with volume driven by AI data-centre build-outs.

businessLines.name: Harsh Environment Solutions
businessLines.how: Sells ruggedized connectors, specialty cable and printed circuit assemblies to defense, industrial, aerospace, automotive and IT customers; one-time product sales specified into long-lived programs.

businessLines.name: Interconnect and Sensor Systems
businessLines.how: Sells sensors, sensor-based systems and value-add interconnect assemblies mainly to automotive and industrial customers; one-time product sales on multi-year platform awards.

brands.name: CommScope Connectivity and Cable Solutions (from Vistance Networks, formerly CommScope Holding)
brands.note: Acquired 2026-01-09; 2026 acquisitions (three, incl. CommScope) cost about $10,684.0M net of cash; CommScope contributed net sales of $2,100.9M from closing to 2026-06-30.
